sources.title: SpaceX Human Spaceflight: ISS
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: HTV 太空站補給船
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學可用走廊為 3 m 時，8 s 延遲案例需拒絕；數值不作任何實機接近規則。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With a 3 m teaching corridor, reject the 8 s case; these numbers are not flight approach rules. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用一維質心帳比較貨物重排，避免只核對總質量。
related.differenceEn: Compare cargo rearrangements with a one-dimensional center-of-mass ledger rather than total mass alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成相對速度 0.2 m/s、偵測延遲 3 s、減速度 0.01 m/s²。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=0.2×3+0.2²/(2×0.01)。 結果約 2.6 m。等加速度教學停止距離 d=vτ+v²/(2a)；忽略軌道耦合、姿態與推力延遲。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩件貨物為 200 kg 於 x=1 m，300 kg 於 x=3 m，忽略船體。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：xcg=(200×1+300×3)/500。 結果約 2.2 m。xcg=Σmixi/Σmi；位置須相對同一基準，僅處理靜態質心，不代表完整慣量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic closing speed is 0.2 m/s, detection delay 3 s and deceleration 0.01 m/s². Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=0.2×3+0.2²/(2×0.01). Result ≈ 2.6 m. Teaching stopping distance d=vτ+v²/(2a) assumes constant deceleration and excludes orbital coupling, attitude and thrust delay.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching cargo items are 200 kg at x=1 m and 300 kg at x=3 m, excluding vehicle structure. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: xcg=(200×1+300×3)/500. Result ≈ 2.2 m. xcg=Σmixi/Σmi requires one reference datum and describes static center of mass, not full inertia.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: FORMOSAT-7/COSMIC-2 福衛七號
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學可用走廊為 3 m 時，8 s 延遲案例需拒絕；數值不作任何實機接近規則。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With a 3 m teaching corridor, reject the 8 s case; these numbers are not flight approach rules. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 把觀測、候傳與處理拆成延遲預算，檢查平均值是否掩蓋逾時。
related.differenceEn: Separate observation, waiting and processing latency and test whether averages hide late data.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成相對速度 0.2 m/s、偵測延遲 3 s、減速度 0.01 m/s²。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：d=0.2×3+0.2²/(2×0.01)。 結果約 2.6 m。等加速度教學停止距離 d=vτ+v²/(2a)；忽略軌道耦合、姿態與推力延遲。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學接收間隔 90 min、處理及傳送固定 15 min，忽略失敗重送。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：平均延遲=90/2+15。 結果約 60 min。規律間隔 T 的下一站等待在均勻相位假設下平均 T/2；最壞近 T，與處理延遲相加。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic closing speed is 0.2 m/s, detection delay 3 s and deceleration 0.01 m/s². Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: d=0.2×3+0.2²/(2×0.01). Result ≈ 2.6 m. Teaching stopping distance d=vτ+v²/(2a) assumes constant deceleration and excludes orbital coupling, attitude and thrust delay.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching contact interval is 90 min plus 15 min fixed processing/transmission, ignoring retries. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Mean latency=90/2+15. Result ≈ 60 min. With regular contact interval T and uniform phase, mean waiting is T/2 and worst case approaches T; add processing latency.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
